resource_clock: sum of per-task max(MONOTONIC,RAW,REALTIME); not host absolute calibration
manual_reading_editing_review_time: outside controlled ledger; no precise active-work-time sampling
build_cost_scope: Target journals retain actual compile events; small tests/probes/cold-build-only tasks are additionally charged in their complete controlled task. Do not sum these subcosts again.
kernel_cost_scope: kernel_totals_by_clock covers journal-instrumented completed measurements only; four direct multi-clock kernel intervals are separate observations, never added again to driver resource cost. Interrupted kernels remain null.
